title: Kimchi Day.
bodyText: November 22 of each year shall be known and designated as "Kimchi Day". This day is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday.
bodyHtml: [§8-40]   Kimchi Day.  November 22 of each year shall be known and designated as "Kimchi Day".  This day is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday. [L 2024, c 8, §2]
